chunks: With this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: concerning a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, what is upon him? He said:
"He gives charity to a poor person in an amount sufficient for his fill."
Its meaning is: if its value reaches the amount of the kaffarah; and that which clarifies this will come.

key_terms.الْكَفَّارَةَ: the expiatory compensation due for a violation
key_terms.شِبَعِهِ: his satiation or fill of food

ai.seo_question: What kaffarah is required if a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a man who has intercourse with his wife while she is in menstruation. The ruling mentioned is to give charity to a poor person in an amount that satisfies his hunger, with an indication that this relates to the measure of kaffarah and is clarified by other reports.
